title: Separate agent-service payments, XRPL ledger transactions, merchant/provider counts and native-XRP demand

decisions.rule: Count service payments separately from XRPL ledger transactions. Batch Checks can settle many service payments in one ledger operation; do not equate dashboard volume with ledger tx count.
Separate XRP, RLUSD and USDC payments by asset and issuer. Aggregate x402 counts cannot be treated as native XRP demand.
Operator dashboards are not independent proof. Reconcile payment IDs and delivered amounts to validated XRPL transactions; investigate 'Unverified' status labels before admitting values.

Registered merchants, merchants with live services, providers and endpoint counts are different units. Large aggregators can contribute thousands of endpoints without representing thousands of independent merchants.
Separate seed investment, named partner participation, MOU, intended integration, closed beta and production deployment. Do not infer XRP settlement from multi-rail partnership membership.
A treasury holding is not a market flow. Do not infer lending, collateral use, market making or sell pressure until deployed amounts and transaction evidence are disclosed.

feature_admission: NONE; T54 counts/value are operator-reported, multi-asset, batchable and not independently reconciled. No x402 observation is admitted as a native-XRP price feature.
